summary: 17-year-old hiker at Snowmass Lake (10,800 ft) showed signs of advanced altitude illness (shortness of breath, vomiting, foaming at mouth) with an asthma condition; MRA hoist-rescue technician performed field evaluation, secured the teen into a redirected HAATS Black Hawk via hoist to Sardy Field; Aspen Ambulance transferred patient to Aspen Valley Hospital
location: Snowmass Lake (10,800 ft), Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen, CO Army National Guard (HAATS), CSAR, Aspen Ambulance, Pitkin County Regional Emergency Dispatch
notes: SOS received 6:50 a.m.; all rescue personnel out of the wilderness by 11 a.m.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Snowmass Mountain)
